summary.textHead: function parsePairs(text) { const result = {}; if (!text) return result; for (const part of text.split(';')) { const idx = part.indexOf('='); if (idx === -1) continue; const key = part.slice(0, idx); const value = part.slice(idx + 1); result[key] = value; } return result; }
